svg.aria-label: Mr. Elite architecture. Interface: Python and FastAPI. Takes a request in plain language. Pipeline: Seven stages that turn the request into an ordered plan. Reasoning: In parallel: policy enforcement, memory retrieval, resource validation. Control: Prompt injection protection and rate limiting, before anything executes. Agents: Email, Calendar, Writing, Documentation and Mr. Happy, routed through LangGraph. Memory: One shared brain on Supabase, so no agent starts from zero. Stages: Intent classification, Task atomization, Context retrieval, Policy validation, Agent execution, Result aggregation, Learning updates
